tutorial.step.intro: You must be the new manager. I'm Bolt. This plant closes at month's end, and old models like me get scrapped. Before then, I'm building a rocket. First, the control panel
tutorial.step.placeSwitch: Pick the Switch from your hand and place it on the glowing tile. It fires a signal where the arrow points
tutorial.step.placeGear: Put the Booster Gear right of the switch. It doubles the signal
tutorial.step.placeDock: Put the Dock right of the gear. Whatever arrives gets shipped
tutorial.step.trial: Hit Test Run to see the flow. Test runs are free. Unlike everything else
tutorial.step.buyGear: Shipped {score}, quota {quota}. Not enough. Buy another Booster Gear in the shop
tutorial.step.moveDock: Drag placed parts to move them. Move the Dock one tile right, onto the glowing ×2 floor. Parts on it double the value
tutorial.step.placeSecondGear: Put the new gear in the gap. Two gears is ×4, the floor makes it ×8. Multiplication never lets you down
tutorial.step.commit: Quota reached. Lock it in with Run. There are no do-overs. Same as HQ
tutorial.step.finish: First part delivered. One last thing: the unofficial factory I've been building on night shifts
tutorial.hint.notReached: The signal never reached the dock. Check that switch, gear and dock face right in a line (tap a part to rotate)
tutorial.hint.short: Still short. Rearrange and test again
howTo.title: How to play
howTo.goal.title: Goal: build the rocket before you're scrapped
howTo.goal.body:
A day has 3 shifts: morning, day, night. 9 shifts over 3 days
Each shift's quota you clear, the manager slips you one rocket part
Clear all 9 and the rocket launches. Miss a quota and the run ends
After launch comes Overtime: the Moon, Mars... the shift goes on. A full clear also unlocks Overtime Levels
howTo.build.title: Building the factory
howTo.build.body:
Buy parts in the shop, then pick them from your inventory and place them on the floor (you get a budget each shift, and leftovers carry over)
Tap a placed part to rotate it, drag to move it. Drag it to the inventory to return it, or to the sell area to sell it (half price)
The switch sends a signal in the direction of its arrow. Each part the signal passes changes its value, and the value that reaches a dock is shipped
Signals that enter an empty cell or leave the floor disappear
Undo (Z / Ctrl+Z) takes back your last place, rotate, move or return (buying, selling and rerolling can't be undone)
Keyboard: arrows move, Enter places, R rotates, Z undoes, F returns to inventory, G merges, T trial, P real run
Controller: D-pad moves, A places, X rotates, Back undoes, RT returns to inventory, LT merges, Y trial, Start real run
howTo.chain.title: Chain tips
howTo.chain.body:
Multiply: gears and presses make values bigger. Stacked multipliers make them skyrocket
Branch: splitters and spreaders make more signals to reach more docks
Retrigger: reflectors and turntables send signals through the same parts again (each part has an activation limit)
Placement: coils and solar panels depend on where they sit. Piggy banks add budget for the next shift
Trial runs are unlimited. Try out a layout before pressing the real switch
Random parts like the Junkbot give different results on each trial. The shift is decided by the real switch
Gold parts: 3 of the same part connected side by side start to glow. Select one and press Merge to turn that cell into a gold part (×3 after its effect; switches and resonance coils can't merge)
howTo.night.title: Night shifts and more
howTo.night.body:
Night shifts have a special rule (low oil, floor repairs and more). You get a preview during the morning and noon shifts
Clear a night shift to pick one of three relics. Relics last until the end of the run
After a run, your records unlock new parts and a bigger factory (see the Collection)
The Weekly Challenge is 3 shifts with the same conditions for everyone all week (one ranked run per day). Your best of the week is ranked worldwide

part.merger.flavor: Turns scattered work into one result, using heat and nerve.

part.inspector.flavor: Becomes remarkably diligent only beside a Shipping Dock.
part.piggyBank.flavor: The only asset Accounting cannot locate.
